title: Linear, support-controlled, sup-norm-bounded slice operator ω ↦ ∫₀¹ ω(ι(t, ·))(e₀, J·) dt
statement: Notation: ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} for t ∈ ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^N; Jv := ι(0, v) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v)); e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{N+1}; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) := TestFormOn univ m and 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) := GeometricCurrentOn univ m (forms and currents on all of ℝ^P = Euclid P); M(T) := T.mass = T.massOn univ; spt T := T.support. Assume (SA): for all N, k ∈ ℕ and ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there is η ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) dt for all x ∈ ℝ^N and v ∈ (ℝ^N)^k, and tsupport η ⊆ {x : ∃ t ∈ [0, 1], ι(t, x) ∈ tsupport ω}; (SE): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, every k-covector α on ℝ^N, every continuous f : ℝ → (k-covectors on ℝ^N) and every c ∈ ℝ with α(v) = ∫_0^1 f(t)(v) dt for all v ∈ (ℝ^N)^k and |f(t)| ≤ c for all t ∈ [0, 1], one has |α| ≤ c; (R1): for all N, k there is a continuous linear map Φ from (k+1)-covectors on ℝ^{N+1} to k-covectors on ℝ^N with Φ(γ)(v_1, …, v_k) = γ(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) for all γ, v and |Φ(γ)| ≤ |γ| for all γ. Then for all N, k ∈ ℕ there is an ℝ-linear map S : 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) → 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) such that (i) S(ω)(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) dt for all ω, x, v; (ii) tsupport S(ω) ⊆ {x : ∃ t ∈ [0, 1], ι(t, x) ∈ tsupport ω} for all ω; (iii) for every ω and c ∈ ℝ with |ω(y)| ≤ c for all y ∈ ℝ^{N+1}, |S(ω)(x)| ≤ c for all x ∈ ℝ^N.
